title: Change XDG user directory location
summary: Update the location of standard user folders like Desktop, Documents, or Downloads. This changes where applications look for these files.

steps.explain: Set the path for a specific XDG directory (e.g., DESKTOP, DOCUMENTS, DOWNLOAD).

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY_NAME
placeholders.description: The XDG directory key to change, e.g., DESKTOP, DOCUMENTS, DOWNLOAD, MUSIC, PICTURES, VIDEOS.

placeholders.name: NEW_PATH
placeholders.description: The absolute path to the new directory.
